entries.defect: Hydraulic pressure fluctuation observed on Green system during approach — gauge reading dropped to 2850 PSI momentarily
entries.action: Hydraulic filter element replaced on Green system. System pressure verified normal at 3000 PSI after ground run. Filter found contaminated.

entries.defect: Engine 2 EGT margin trending 15°C higher than Engine 1 over last 5 flights
entries.action: FADEC data download performed. Fuel nozzle flow check satisfactory. EGT probe resistance checked — within limits. Monitoring continues per MEL.

entries.defect: Main gear RH inboard tire showing uneven wear pattern on tread shoulder
entries.action: Tire replaced at position 3. Wheel alignment checked within limits. Brake assembly inspected — no abnormalities found.

entries.defect: APU start time exceeding normal parameters — 62 seconds vs. normal 45 seconds. EGT peak at 1050°C
entries.action: APU inlet door mechanism lubricated. Starter motor brushes inspected — slight wear noted but within limits. APU compartment cleaned of debris.

entries.defect: ECAM caution: BLEED 1 FAULT during climb through FL250. Pack 1 auto-selected off.
entries.action: Bleed valve 1 tested on ground — intermittent response noted. Bleed valve replaced per AMM 36-11-01. Leak check satisfactory post replacement.

entries.defect: Galley power outlet 3L inoperative — no output voltage measured
entries.action: Circuit breaker found tripped on P320 panel. Reset and output verified 115V AC. Wiring inspection found no anomalies. Monitoring for recurrence.

entries.defect: Forward passenger door L1 — crew reports increased force required to open
entries.action: Door assist mechanism inspected. Hinge bearings found dry. Bearings lubricated and door operation verified satisfactory. Seal compression checked — within limits.

entries.defect: ECAM memo: SLATS FAULT — Slat channel 1 disagreement during pre-flight
entries.action: SFCC BITE check performed. No fault codes stored. Slat position sensors checked and re-rigged per AMM 27-81-01. Full retraction/extension cycle satisfactory.

entries.defect: Cabin zone 2 temperature cannot be reduced below 26°C — passenger complaint
entries.action: Zone controller recalibrated. Trim air valve actuator found sluggish — replaced per AMM 21-61-01. Post-replacement, zone temperature controllable to 18°C.

entries.defect: Bleed air leak suspected at precooler duct area — maintenance crew detected abnormal heat in zone
entries.action: Precooler duct clamp found loose. Clamp tightened and leak check performed using soap solution — no further leaks detected. Area re-inspected after engine run.

entries.defect: Yellow system hydraulic quantity indication fluctuating on ECAM
entries.action: Reservoir quantity transmitter connector cleaned and secured. Ground test showed stable indication. Sensor resistance within tolerance. No leak found.

entries.defect: Engine 1 — slight oil leak observed at accessory gearbox area during daily inspection
entries.action: Oil leak traced to gearbox cover gasket. Gasket replaced per AMM 71-11-05. Oil replenished to full. No further leak after engine run.
